subject.title: feat(mac): show native notification permission in dashboard Notifications settings

question: Should the embedded macOS Dashboard expose native notification permission and test controls through a dedicated trusted WebKit bridge rather than retain browser-only notification settings?
rationale: This is a new user-facing host integration and an additional page-to-native action boundary; correctness evidence alone cannot determine whether that permanent product and security contract is desired.

options.title: Accept the native Dashboard mode
options.body: Approve the narrow macOS-only bridge after reviewing its trust checks and receiving redacted live proof for permission and test-notification flows.

options.title: Keep browser-only settings
options.body: Decline the host-specific settings mode and retain the existing web-push-only UI outside a future macOS product decision.

recommendation.title: Accept the native Dashboard mode
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow macOS-only bridge after reviewing its trust checks and receiving redacted live proof for permission and test-notification flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this contributor directly to the macOS Dashboard and Control UI proposal, though independent current-main ownership history could not be established.
